executive_summary: Indian manufacturing SMEs face mandatory GST e-invoicing and e-way bill obligations, which creates a recurring compliance workload that software can absorb. Official turnover thresholds and filing mechanics are published by the GST authority and should be confirmed against the current notification before pricing or positioning. Demand concentration in established manufacturing clusters supports a focused four-city entry rather than a national launch.

facts.statement: GST registration, return filing and e-invoicing requirements for businesses are published and maintained on the official GST portal.
National accounts and household consumption statistics used for market sizing are published by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.

assumptions.statement: Roughly 12% of manufacturing SMEs in the four target cities are actively seeking to replace spreadsheet-based GST workflows within 18 months.
assumptions.rationale: Derived from observed replacement cycles in adjacent compliance-software categories; no primary survey has been conducted for this segment.
assumptions.validation_method: Run 30 structured discovery interviews across the four cities and measure stated intent plus current tooling.

assumptions.statement: Finance managers, not owner-operators, are the primary economic buyer in firms above 50 employees.
assumptions.rationale: Larger firms typically delegate compliance tooling decisions; unverified for this segment.
assumptions.validation_method: Record the decision-maker role in every sales conversation for the first 40 deals.

estimates.metric: average revenue per account per month

recommendations.action: Run 30 discovery interviews across Pune, Ahmedabad, Coimbatore and Delhi-NCR before committing to a pricing tier.
Confirm current GST e-invoicing turnover thresholds with a chartered accountant before publishing any compliance claim in marketing.

risks.description: Market sizing rests on an unvalidated adoption-intent assumption, so the revenue model may be materially overstated.
risks.mitigation: Gate the seed spend on completing discovery interviews and revising E001 before scaling acquisition.
risks.early_warning_indicator: Fewer than 8 of the first 30 interviews express active replacement intent.

dependencies.note: E001 and E002 feed the revenue model.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
sources.title: National accounts, consumption and household survey statistics

confidence.basis: Regulatory mechanics are traceable to primary sources, but all demand sizing rests on an unvalidated adoption assumption.

unanswered_questions: What is the actual willingness to pay among firms under 50 employees?
How many target firms already use an accountant-provided filing service?
